```bicep
guid(roleDefinitionId, managedIdentity.id, resourceGroup().id)
```

why is this needed? since the AGW assignment has already taken place?  What step is left to "fail"?

discussion_comments.comment_body: the seed for the guid() function must contain the principal, role and scope.  Because you're using outputs from the other modules, you won't be able to use the principal in the name directly, so may be easier to also make the roleAssignment a module.
